'''''Melica minuta''''' is a species of [[Poaceae|grass]] that can be found in the [[Mediterranean Basin]], from Portugal and Morocco to the [[Eastern Mediterranean]].<ref name=kew>{{cite web|url=http://www.kew.org/data/grasses-db/www/imp06161.htm|author1=W.D. Clayton |author2=M. Vorontsova |author3=K.T. Harman |author4=H. Williamson |title=''Melica minuta''|publisher=GrassBase|work=The Board of Trustees, [[Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew|Royal Botanic Gardens]]|location=[[Kew]]|date=November 16, 2012|accessdate=June 28, 2013}}</ref>

==Description==
The species is [[perennial plant|perennial]] and have {{convert|20|–|50|cm}} long [[culm (botany)|culms]]. Both the leaf-sheaths and the leaf-blades have [[glabrousness|glabrous]] surface. The other features are different though; Leaf-sheaths are tubular and are closed on one end while leaf-blades are {{convert|1|–|2|mm}} wide and are hairy as well. The eciliated margin have a [[ligule]] that is {{convert|3.5|mm}} long. The [[panicle]] is linear, open, nodding, and is {{convert|3|–|12|cm}} long with the main [[branch]]es of the panicle are spread out. They carry 7–30 fertile [[spikelet]]s.<ref name=kew/>

Spikelets are oblong, solitary, are {{convert|7|-|9|mm}} long and are [[pedicel (botany)|pediceled]]. They also have 2 fertile florets which are diminished at the apex. The sterile florets are also present in a number of 2-3, and are barren, cuneate, and [[Sessility (zoology)|clumped]]. Both the upper and lower [[glumes]] are keelless, membranous, oblong and have acute apexes. Their size is different though; Lower glume is {{convert|5|-|7|mm}} long, while the upper one is {{convert|6.5|-|8|mm}} long.<ref name=kew/>

Its [[lemma (botany)|lemma]] have scaberulous surface with the fertile lemma being chartaceous, keelless, oblong, ovate and of the same size as the upper glume. Lemma have an acute apex, with [[palea (botany)|palea]] being 2-[[leaf vein|veined]]. Flowers are fleshy, oblong and truncate. They also grow together, have 2 [[lodicule]]s and 3 [[stamen|anthers]]. The [[fruit]]s have [[caryopsis]], are {{convert|2.5|–|3|mm}} long with additional pericarp and linear [[hilum (biology)|hilum]].<ref name=kew/>
